info.name: Bookwise - Booking API
info.description:
Functional test collection for the Bookwise booking CRUD API. Run requests in the Booking lifecycle folder from top to bottom. The collection checks POST idempotency replay, listing, details, update, and soft cancellation.

Before running:

1. Start the Bookwise app at [http://localhost:3000](http://localhost:3000).
    
2. Sign in through the app and select an active organization.
    
3. Set the environment variables customerId and serviceId to active records belonging to that organization.
    
4. Set sessionCookie to the complete Cookie header value copied from an authenticated localhost request in browser DevTools. Do not include the leading word 'Cookie:'.
    
5. Use a new idempotencyKey for each fresh create test cycle.
    

DELETE is a soft cancellation: the booking remains retrievable with status CANCELLED.

item.name: Booking lifecycle

request.description: Creates a PENDING booking. Price, currency, service duration, and end time are taken from the selected service on the server.

item.name: 2. Replay create request (same key and body)

request.description: Send the identical payload with the identical Idempotency-Key. It should replay the stored response, not create a second booking.

exec: pm.test('returns 200 OK', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
const body = pm.response.json();

pm.test('returns bookings and pagination metadata', function () { pm.expect(body).to.have.nested.property('data.bookings'); pm.expect(body.data.bookings).to.be.an('array'); pm.expect(body).to.have.nested.property('data.pagination.total'); });

request.description: Lists bookings for the active organization. Optional filters: status, from, and to (ISO 8601 timestamps).

exec: pm.test('returns 200 OK', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
const body = pm.response.json();
pm.test('booking status is CONFIRMED', function () { pm.expect(body).to.have.nested.property('data.booking.status', 'CONFIRMED'); });

request.description: Changes the created booking to CONFIRMED and moves its start time. The API should recalculate endsAt using the service duration stored on the booking.

exec: pm.test('returns 200 OK', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
const body = pm.response.json();
pm.test('booking is marked CANCELLED', function () { pm.expect(body).to.have.nested.property('data.booking.status', 'CANCELLED'); });

request.description: This endpoint performs a soft cancellation, not a physical database deletion.

exec: pm.test('repeat cancellation returns 200 OK', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });

request.description: Repeating cancellation for an already-cancelled booking should succeed without changing its outcome.

item.description: Run these requests in order. The Create request stores bookingId; Replay verifies the same request returns the same booking.
